outcome: Neonatal outcomes (body weight, body length, Apgar score)
cohort: 1,178 women with PPROM admitted to Beijing Obstetrics and Gynecology Hospital in 2012, 2014, and 2017
finding: The incidence rate of PPROM varied between the years studied, with age, intrauterine infection, and vaginitis identified as risk factors; vaginal delivery was the preferred mode of delivery, and while most neonatal outcomes were similar across groups, a significant difference in Apgar scores at 1 minute was observed at 28-33(+6) weeks.
mod_finding: Patients with PPROM tended to choose vaginal delivery rather than cesarean section.
birth_weight: Measured, but specific values not mentioned
